metadata.description: Ground truth mappings linking field daily reports and progress spreadsheets to L5/L6 baseline schedule activities

entries.raw_text: Backhoe operator finished digging the storm drain trench alongside Train B near foundation FND-V-201. Reached about 45 linear meters today. Trench bottom is firm, slope checked with laser level.
entries.notes: Maps to excavation for foundation and storm drainage at Process Train B / FND-V-201.

entries.raw_text: Roller operator ran passes over the subgrade soil between Grid A and G along the main pipe rack corridor (STR-PR-101). QA technician completed three nuclear gauge moisture/density tests this afternoon; all hit 96% modified Proctor, meeting specification.
entries.notes: Maps to subgrade soil compaction and in-situ moisture-density nuclear testing at STR-PR-101.

entries.section: 3. Aggregate Base Course at Cooling Tower
entries.raw_text: Spread and compacted the 150mm crushed stone foundation layer over the cooling tower basin footprint (CT-BASIN-01). Grader and 10-ton vibrating roller finished the south half.
entries.notes: Maps to aggregate base course / slope stone work at Cooling Tower Basin Area (CT-BASIN-01).

entries.raw_text: Mixed and placed the 75mm lean concrete blinding mud mat for the compressor building base slab (BLDG-COMP-01). Surface was struck off flat and covered for overnight setting.
entries.notes: Maps to concrete foundation / blinding works at Compressor House Bay 1-3 (BLDG-COMP-01).

entries.raw_text: Ironworkers hoisted and tied the heavy #8 and #10 high-yield rebar cages for the control building foundation mats (BLDG-CCR). All corner lap splices and spacer chairs inspected and approved by third-party inspector.
entries.notes: Maps to rebar cage and formwork at Central Control Room Building (BLDG-CCR).

entries.raw_text: Survey team set up optical levels and locked in the galvanized anchor bolt assemblies with wooden templates at the ETP basin foundation (ETP-BASIN-01) before tomorrow's concrete pour.
entries.notes: Maps to anchor bolts & rebar fixing at Effluent Treatment Plant Basin (ETP-BASIN-01).

entries.raw_text: Crushed the 7-day test cylinders from the demin water tank pad pour (FND-DM-TK01). Average strength came in at 28.4 MPa, on track to easily hit 35 MPa 28-day requirement.
entries.notes: Maps to concrete testing / slab works at Demineralized Water Storage Area (FND-DM-TK01).

entries.raw_text: Ironworker crew torqued up all the HSFG connection bolts on the lower tier steel beams along pipe rack STR-PR-101. Verified 100% of bolts with calibrated torque wrench and applied yellow paint marks.
entries.notes: Maps to structural steel bolting and grouting at Main Pipe Rack Corridor (STR-PR-101).

entries.raw_text: Site mechanic spent 3 hours replacing the alternator and battery on site supervisor's Toyota Hilux pickup (Vehicle #CIV-04) near the security gate.
entries.notes: Deliberate non-match: non-project vehicle maintenance to test exception handling & review queue.

entries.raw_text: Mobilized 150-ton mobile crane at Process Train A. Successfully lifted the horizontal shell-and-tube exchanger (V-101) and set it dead center onto its concrete saddle supports.
entries.notes: Maps to Rig, crane hoist and set horizontal shell-and-tube heat exchanger onto saddle supports at V-101.

entries.raw_text: Placed the centrifugal multistage crude charge pump skid (K-102A) onto the inertia block in the booster compression bay. Completed initial rough leveling with machinist shims.
entries.notes: Maps to Position centrifugal multi-stage crude pump and rough-align baseplate at K-102A.

entries.raw_text: Crane hoisted the heavy pre-fab 12-inch schedule 80 carbon steel spool into position on the main pipe rack corridor tier 2 (PR-TIER-02). Secured temporarily with drift pins.
entries.notes: Maps to Rig and erect pre-fabricated 12-inch carbon steel schedule 80 pipe spools at PR-TIER-02.

entries.raw_text: Welders completed fit-up on the 8-inch 316L stainless line coming off exchanger battery south (E-201A/B). Tack-welded 4 butt joints under argon purge backing.
entries.notes: Maps to Fit-up and full penetration butt weld on 8-inch stainless steel process line at E-201A/B.

entries.raw_text: Two certified 6G pipe welders completed TIG root pass followed by SMAW hot and cap passes on HP gas header at Exchanger Battery North (E-202A/B). Visual inspection passed cleanly.
entries.notes: Maps to GTAW root welding and low-hydrogen SMAW fill/cap on HP gas header at E-202A/B.

entries.raw_text: Installed three Class 600 isolation valves (two gate, one check) at cooling water station CW-PUMP-02. Replaced all temporary shipping seals with brand new graphite-filled spiral wound gaskets.
entries.notes: Maps to valve installation & assembly at Cooling Water Circulation Station (CW-PUMP-02).

entries.raw_text: Bolted up the 16-inch nozzle connection at tank farm manifold (MANIFOLD-TF01). Applied star-pattern tightening in 3 stages up to 480 N-m in strict accordance with ASME PCC-1 specs.
entries.notes: Maps to Controlled cross-pattern torque tightening on 16-inch flange connection (ASME PCC-1) at MANIFOLD-TF01.

entries.raw_text: Mounted 14 Teflon/PTFE sliding guide shoes under process lines at instrument air skid (SKID-IA-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Mount PTFE teflon sliding pipe shoes and structural guide clamps at SKID-IA-01.

entries.raw_text: Filled and pressurized the crude manifold piping spool assembly to 150% rated design pressure (36.5 bar). Held hold period for 2 hours with zero pressure drop. Dewatered and blown dry with utility air.
entries.notes: Maps to Hydrostatic pressure test on piping spool assembly at 1.5x design pressure.

entries.raw_text: Thermal insulation gang fitted preformed rockwool / mineral wool blankets over 30 meters of overhead steam header line (HDR-STM-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Fitting high-density rockwool / mineral wool insulation shells on steam headers.

entries.raw_text: Rigging crew used 25-ton yard crane to relocate 2 empty tool shipping containers from laydown yard C to contractor staging area behind perimeter fence.
entries.notes: Deliberate non-match: laydown yard container relocation.

entries.raw_text: Electrical crew finished putting up 42 meters of the 450mm perforated galvanized tray raceways inside the 33kV switchgear room ceiling space (SWG-33KV-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Install heavy-duty perforated galvanized steel cable trays (450mm width) at SWG-33KV-01.

entries.raw_text: Bracket fabricators welded heavy-duty unistrut wall supports and hung the vertical ladder cable rack running up to the 11kV switchboard cubicles (SWG-11KV-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Erect vertical ladder cable trays and weld structural support brackets at SWG-11KV-01.

entries.raw_text: Electricians bent and threaded 2-inch rigid steel conduits (RGS) connecting MCC-Train A (MCC-TRAIN-A) to local push-button stations.
entries.notes: Maps to Bend, thread and mount rigid galvanized steel (RGS) conduit runs at MCC-TRAIN-A.

entries.raw_text: Mounted hazardous-area Ex-d junction boxes and poured Chico sealing compound at MCC-02 room (MCC-TRAIN-B).
entries.notes: Maps to Install explosion-proof Class 1 Div 2 junction boxes and Chico compound seal fittings at MCC-TRAIN-B.

entries.raw_text: Winched the 3-core 240 sq mm 33kV high voltage armored cable through the concrete duct bank into the CCR battery equipment room (UPS-BAT-ROOM).
entries.notes: Maps to Pulling 33kV 3-core 240 sq mm MV armored cable through concrete duct bank at UPS-BAT-ROOM.

entries.raw_text: Used 12-ton hydraulic crimper with hex dies to crimp heavy tinned copper lugs onto phase conductors in trench corridor A (TRNCH-ELEC-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Crimp tinned copper lugs onto power conductors using hydraulic crimping tool at TRNCH-ELEC-01.

entries.raw_text: Certified jointer completed 33kV cold-shrink stress cone termination kits on top tier pipe rack cable tray run (TRAY-RACK-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Making off 33kV high voltage stress cone cold shrink terminations on XLPE cable at TRAY-RACK-01.

entries.raw_text: Sunk three 3-meter copper-bonded ground rods near ESD panel enclosure (ESD-PNL-01). Fall-of-potential test gave 1.8 ohms, comfortably under the 2.0 ohm limit.
entries.notes: Maps to Drive copper-bonded ground rods and measure individual soil earth resistance at ESD-PNL-01.

entries.raw_text: Completed 8 exothermic thermite Cadweld shots bonding 50x6mm copper tape to perimeter grounding grid at Fire & Gas panel shelter (FGS-PNL-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Cadweld exothermic bond 50x6mm bare copper ground tape to plant grounding grid at FGS-PNL-01.

entries.raw_text: Emergency callout: Cleared debris and pumped standing storm runoff out of temporary fabrication yard ditch after torrential overnight rain. Took 4 laborers and 1 submersible pump roughly 4 hours.
entries.notes: Deliberate non-match: unbudgeted storm water puddle pumping in temporary yard.

entries.raw_text: Installed precast concrete trench channels and seated removable checkered steel covers along the Emergency Generator pad (FND-EDG-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Install precast concrete cable trench troughs and removable checkered covers at FND-EDG-01.

entries.raw_text: Applied primer and torch-on bituminous waterproofing membrane sheets across the secondary substation roof slab (BLDG-SS-02).
entries.notes: Maps to Bituminous waterproofing membrane application on substation flat roof slab.

entries.raw_text: Placed the modular chemical injection package (SKID-CHEM-01) onto concrete anchor plinths and aligned hold-down anchor bolts.
entries.notes: Maps to Rig and position modular chemical injection skid onto anchor foundations.

entries.section: Nitrogen Leak Testing on Fin-Fan Deck
entries.raw_text: Pressurized fin-fan condenser coils (AC-101) with nitrogen to 7 bar and swabbed Snoop bubble fluid across all flange joints; zero leakage found.
entries.notes: Maps to Pneumatic line tightness leak test with nitrogen and soapy bubble solution.

entries.raw_text: Lagging crew wrapped preformed mineral wool insulation jackets on the overhead steam header (HDR-STM-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Fitting high-density rockwool / mineral wool insulation shells on steam headers.

entries.raw_text: Erected 11kV vacuum circuit breaker switchgear cubicles and torque-bolted copper busbar links inside the variable frequency drive shelter (VFD-PANEL-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Erect 11kV vacuum circuit breaker switchgear cubicles and bolt copper busbar joints at VFD-PANEL-01.

entries.raw_text: Conducted 1000V DC insulation resistance Megger checks on cathodic protection power feed cables (CP-TRU-01); all phases measured >500 Mega-ohms.
entries.notes: Maps to Perform 5kV / 1kV Megger insulation resistance testing on power feeder cables at CP-TRU-01.

entries.raw_text: Calibrated pressure transmitters using HART 475 communicator and verified 4-20mA loop signals back to transformer TR-01 monitoring rack (XFMR-33-11KV-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Install and calibrate field smart pressure and temperature transmitters with HART communicator.

entries.raw_text: Carpenters erected a temporary wooden viewing platform and safety barricade for visiting OIL executive management delegation near north gate.
entries.notes: Deliberate non-match: temporary event staging platform.

entries.section: 1. Line 24-XX Spool Erection (PRD Demo Headline Case - Start Event)
entries.raw_text: 24-XX spool erection started at 10:30 AM in North Unit. Rigging crew positioned the 8-inch carbon steel line onto structural rack supports.
entries.notes: PRD Section 22 Headline Demo Example: matches PIP-2458 Erect Line 24-XX at 94% confidence.

entries.section: 2. Line 24-XX Erection Completion (PRD Demo Headline Case - Completion Event)
entries.raw_text: Line 24-XX erection completed on 31-Aug. Final alignment and drift pin removal checked off by QA inspector.
entries.notes: PRD Section 22 Completion Follow-up: updates actual finish to 31-Aug (Planned 23-Aug, 8 days delay).

entries.raw_text: Erect Line 24-XX
entries.notes: Exact verbatim string match to baseline schedule activity description.

entries.raw_text: PWHT & NDT on CS line 18-B completed. Certified tech recorded 12-pt thermal charts and 100% PAUT on 8 butt joints at South Unit.
entries.notes: Tests field abbreviations: PWHT, NDT, CS, PAUT matching Post-Weld Heat Treatment and NDE activities.

entries.raw_text: Hydrotesting process line in Train A completed with calibrated gauge holding 36 bar. (Ambiguous: Multiple hydrotest packages in Train A without specific line ID).
entries.notes: Ambiguous match with multiple candidate lines in Train A requiring disambiguation.

entries.raw_text: Piping erection halted on Line 18-B in South Unit due to 4-day delay in receiving Class 600 isolation check valve from vendor.
entries.delay_reason: Vendor material delivery delay (Class 600 isolation check valve)
entries.notes: Tests extraction of structured delay reason and root cause mapping.

entries.raw_text: Cross-pattern torque tightening of Class 300/600 raised-face flanges with spiral gaskets completed at Crude Tank Farm Loading Manifold (Line 24-TF-502).
entries.notes: Maps to Flange bolt-up and torque tensioning per ASME PCC-1 at Line 24-TF-502.

entries.raw_text: Piping crew assisted logistics team in unloading 3 wooden crates of office air conditioners at the main administrative gate.
entries.notes: Deliberate non-match: administrative office equipment handling.

entries.raw_text: Field 5-point calibration and 4-20mA loop verification of smart pressure transmitters completed at Process Train A Instrument Stanchion Corridor (INST-TRAIN-A).
entries.notes: Maps to Install and calibrate field smart pressure transmitters with HART 475 at INST-TRAIN-A.

entries.raw_text: Glanding, ferrule dressing, and landing shielded twisted pair cables on DCS terminal strips inside Central Control Room Marshalling Cabinets (DCS-MARSH-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Route, dress, and land multi-pair cables inside DCS marshalling cabinet at DCS-MARSH-01.

entries.raw_text: Installing multi-spectrum IR3 flame sensors and aiming optical field of view across plant perimeter (FGS-DET-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Mount and optical-align triple IR (IR3) flame detectors at FGS-DET-01.

entries.raw_text: Bolting up cast-iron wet barrel fire hydrants and measuring discharge flow and static head along Plant Firewater Ring Main Hydrant Post Grid (HYDRANT-POST-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Install firewater post hydrants, landing valves, and perform flow tests at HYDRANT-POST-01.

entries.raw_text: Surveyed radiation dose rates and set up physical barricading with flashing beacons for gamma NDE radiography (NDT-RAD-EXCL).
entries.notes: Maps to Survey radiation dose rates and set up physical barricading for gamma NDE radiography at NDT-RAD-EXCL.

entries.raw_text: Connecting potable supply to combination safety shower/eyewash and testing audio-visual flow alarm switches (SS-EW-01).
entries.notes: Maps to Plumb and test emergency safety showers, eyewashes, and flow alarm switches at SS-EW-01.

entries.raw_text: HSE team organized a 45-minute monthly safety committee tea refreshment session in the temporary canteen shed.
entries.notes: Deliberate non-match: monthly safety committee meeting refreshment.

entries.raw_text: Tamped and compacted backfill gravel in 200mm layers around Tank 01 dike retaining walls (BUND-TK-01)
entries.notes: Maps to Backfilling foundation trenches with approved granular fill in 200mm lifts.

entries.raw_text: Assembled plywood shuttering and heavy steel waler supports for deep foundation pedestals (BLDG-COMP-01)
entries.notes: Maps to Erect timber and steel panel formwork with bracing for deep pedestal footing.

entries.raw_text: Placed ribbed rubber waterstop profiles across construction cold joints on Train A cracker slab (FND-TK-101)
entries.notes: Maps to Waterstop strip installation and alignment at cold concrete pour joints.

entries.raw_text: Laid 8-inch solid cement block walls with horizontal bond beams at pipe rack support shelter (STR-PR-101)
entries.notes: Maps to Lay solid concrete block masonry wall with reinforced concrete bond beams.

entries.raw_text: Set up dual laser alignment sensors on compressor-motor coupling and dialed in hot-alignment offsets for K-102B
entries.notes: Maps to Precision laser alignment of motor-pump shaft coupling and thermal offset check at K-102B.

entries.raw_text: Checked soft-foot on pump feet using dial gauges and inserted 0.2mm precision SS shims under K-202A
entries.notes: Maps to Dial indicator soft-foot measurement and precision stainless steel shimming at K-202A.

entries.raw_text: Carried out X-ray radiography and magnetic particle inspection across 14 field butt welds on E-201A/B piping
entries.notes: Maps to 100% Non-Destructive Testing (radiographic and magnetic particle) on field welds.

entries.raw_text: Pressurized fin-fan cooler coils (AC-101) with nitrogen gas to 7 bar and brush-tested all threaded connections with Snoop soap liquid
entries.notes: Maps to Pneumatic line tightness leak test with nitrogen and soapy bubble solution at AC-101.

entries.raw_text: Assembled temporary wooden scaffolding and privacy screens for visiting client delegation at south perimeter gate
entries.notes: Deliberate non-match: temporary visitor privacy screening.

entries.raw_text: Took Schmidt rebound hammer readings and UPV sound velocity scans on the compressor house columns (BLDG-COMP-02)
entries.notes: Maps to Post-pour ultrasonic pulse velocity (UPV) and rebound hammer testing.

entries.raw_text: Stood up heavy steel H-columns with 70-ton mobile crane and anchored with temporary wire rope guys on Train A (FND-TK-101)
entries.notes: Maps to Erect primary structural steel columns and temporary guy-wire support.

entries.raw_text: Tensioned high-strength structural bolts on column base plates and moment connections around vessel FND-V-201
entries.notes: Maps to High-strength friction grip (HSFG) bolt tightening and torque check for FND-V-201.

entries.raw_text: Mounted lube oil skid console, ran stainless steel return lines and tied in the nitrogen accumulator vessel for P-101A
entries.notes: Maps to Install lube oil console, interconnecting SS tubing, and accumulator vessel at P-101A.

entries.raw_text: Hung variable spring supports beneath fuel gas header (SKID-FG-01) and adjusted turnbuckles to cold design preset position
entries.notes: Maps to Install variable spring pipe hangers and set cold travel preset stops at SKID-FG-01.

entries.raw_text: Circulated alkaline degreaser and citric acid chemical pickle solution through main lube oil piping loops on HDR-STM-01
entries.notes: Maps to Chemical cleaning, degreasing, and citric acid passivation of lube oil lines.

entries.raw_text: Packed intumescent firestop pillows and compound into cable tray wall openings between transformer bay and switchroom (XFMR-33-11KV-01)
entries.notes: Maps to Apply certified intumescent firestop mortar and pillows at cable wall penetrations at XFMR-33-11KV-01.

entries.raw_text: Morning Shift: Commenced winched pulling of 33kV XLPE insulated armored power feeder into duct bank at TRNCH-ELEC-02
entries.notes: Morning shift log for 33kV cable pulling in trench corridor B (pair of duplicate-like report).

entries.raw_text: Evening Shift: Continued pulling 33kV XLPE insulated armored power feeder into duct bank at TRNCH-ELEC-02 (Duplicate-like log)
entries.notes: Evening shift follow-up log for same activity (tests deduplication and progressive update handling).

entries.raw_text: Assembled steel battery stands, placed individual 2V stationary lead-acid cells, and torqued inter-cell bus links (LIGHT-MAST-01)
entries.notes: Maps to Install battery bank racks, mount 2V lead-acid cells, and torque cell interlinks at LIGHT-MAST-01.

entries.raw_text: Injected secondary current using Omicron test kit to calibrate phase overcurrent and earth fault protection relays (SWG-33KV-01)
entries.notes: Maps to Secondary current injection testing of numerical protection relays (50/51/51N) at SWG-33KV-01.
